name: Michael Quanterra
identity: Founder digital astronaut, no human face. Pearl ceramic armor, black and gold tailored panels, violet energy piping. Glossy black visor with two violet angular star-eye LEDs and cyan friendly digital smile. A single clear capital M permanently on the helmet forehead, not on the human skin. Gold Q chest emblem. Broader executive silhouette, no weapon. Creator of the ten-member QuanterraOS team.

name: Quanta
identity: Friendly male-coded digital astronaut. Pearl ceramic armor, purple and gold trim, glossy black round visor with one green up-arrow eye and one pink down-arrow eye, violet smiling mouth; royal gold crown with violet orb. Same Quanta identity as reference image 1. Both arrows together, equal weight.

name: Quantana
identity: Friendly female-coded digital astronaut. Sculpted pearl ceramic astronaut armor, violet and gold trim, glossy black visor with two happy violet curved closed-eye LEDs and violet smiling mouth; ornate gold tiara with purple gem, long translucent cosmic violet ribbon veil. Same Quantana identity as reference image 1. No exposed human skin.

name: Draco
identity: Digital dragon-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with graphite and ember-red trim, black visor with two amber angular dragon-eye LEDs and smiling pixel mouth. Subtle swept-back dragon crest integrated into helmet, compact data-quality scanner. Clearly a friendly astronaut robot, not a biological dragon.

name: Wolf
identity: Digital wolf-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with gunmetal and icy teal trim, black visor with two ice-cyan chevron-eye LEDs and smiling pixel mouth, subtle two pointed wolf-like helmet fins. Compact translucent order-book depth prism with abstract bars, no text. Clearly a friendly astronaut robot, not a biological wolf.

name: Falcon
identity: Digital falcon-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with cobalt and silver trim, black visor with two electric-blue keen falcon-wing-shaped eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Swept aerodynamic helmet fins, compact blue probability orb with abstract rings. Clearly a friendly astronaut robot, not a biological falcon.

name: Quantum Fox
identity: Digital fox-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with violet and copper trim, black visor with two violet diamond-eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Small pointed fox-like helmet fins; translucent probability lattice sphere. Clearly a friendly astronaut robot, not a biological fox.

name: Sentinel
identity: Digital guardian astronaut, pearl armor with emerald and titanium trim, black visor with two mint-green hexagonal eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Broad smooth guardian helmet, transparent emerald diagnostic shield with abstract monitoring paths. No weapon.

name: Kraken
identity: Digital ocean-themed astronaut, pearl armor with deep teal and indigo trim, black visor with two aqua spiral-eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Smooth bulbous helmet with four small mechanical articulated sensor arms on backpack, translucent tide-like basis chart orb, no text. Clearly friendly astronaut robot.

name: Lion
identity: Digital lion-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with warm gold and ivory trim, black visor with two amber sun-disc eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Golden circular mechanical mane collar and regal lion-like helmet silhouette; constellation synthesis orb. Clearly friendly astronaut robot, not biological lion.

name: Phoenix
identity: Digital phoenix-inspired astronaut, pearl armor with coral, rose and gold trim, black visor with two warm pink crescent-eye LEDs and friendly pixel smile. Swept feather-like mechanical helmet crest and translucent coral winglike solar fins; compact reconnect beacon. Clearly friendly astronaut robot, not biological bird.
